title: Speedy Chinese Barbecue Tofu Noodles
subtitle: with Capsicum and Spring Onion
description: Five easy steps, minimal pans and prep… we cut the fluff but not the flavour in our speedy recipes. In just 20 minutes, you’ll have this masterpiece on the table and be crowned in glory too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the noodles. Thinly slice the capsicum. Thinly slice the white part of the spring onion and cut the green part into 4cm lengths. Crush or finely chop the garlic. Shred the carrot using a julienne peeler (see Kitchen 101) or cut into thin matchsticks. Quarter the tofu pieces.

Cook noodles: Cook the noodles in the pan of boiling water for 2 mins or until tender. Drain, then rinse under hot water to prevent the noodles from sticking. Meanwhile, combine 1½ tbs barbecue sauce, 2 tsp soy sauce and 1 tbs water in a bowl.

Warm tofu: Put the garlic, half the Chinese barbecue seasoning and a drizzle of vegetable oil in a large bowl, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Add the tofu and toss to coat. Heat a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the tofu for 2 mins each side or until golden and warmed through. Remove from the pan.

Stir-fry veggies: Heat a drizzle of vegetable oil in the same pan over high heat. Stir-fry the capsicum for 2 mins or until tender. Add the carrot, spring onion lengths and remaining Chinese barbecue seasoning and cook, stirring, for 30 secs or until fragrant. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Serve up: Add the tofu, noodles and sauce mixture to the veggies and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until combined and warmed through. Divide the tofu noodles among bowls, scatter over the remaining spring onion and enjoy!

Kitchen 101: Do you own a julienne peeler? We love using it in our recipes, as it makes short work of veggie prep. It looks similar to a veggie peeler but with serrated teeth. You simply drag the peeler along the vegetable – and voila! – you have a pretty pile of professional-looking julienne strips.
